info.title: Kiln Phase 1 API
info.description: Contributor contract: fake lifecycle and read-only discovery, plus a separately enabled, administrator-only Proxmox lifecycle qualification. General live provisioning and gateway repair remain disabled.

200.description: The store can read the installation identity

get.summary: Read the newest 100 operations for an authorized resource
get.description: Returns sanitized journal state. Pending and unknown operations block conflicting mutations. Provider task handles, ownership snapshots and raw provider errors are never returned.

403.description: Credential lacks read scope or resource belongs to another project

post.summary: Create a simulated protected gateway in fake-provider mode

200.description: Short-lived raw bearer token; never persisted in readable form

get.summary: Fetch an immutable probe plan from the enrollment HTTPS listener
get.description: Served only by the configured server-authenticated TLS 1.3 enrollment listener. It uses the scoped probe bearer token, not the management API credential.

post.summary: Submit one bounded diagnostic result to the enrollment HTTPS listener
post.description: Served only by the configured server-authenticated TLS 1.3 enrollment listener. Results are diagnostic and cannot change workload admission.

200.description: Accepted result or exact replay acknowledgement

400.description: Result does not exactly match the plan

post.summary: Verify a signed bounded fake artifact and import a simulated managed template
post.description: Requires the separate infrastructure credential. Maximum decoded artifact size is 128 KiB. Signer trust comes from operator configuration; this does not import a real Proxmox image.
Requires the infrastructure credential. Retirement prevents new clones; it does not delete provider disks. Live or unresolved dependencies deny retirement.

get.summary: Read a sanitized project-scoped provenance summary

200.description: Sanitized summary, or null when no plan exists. A missing plan never grants lifecycle authority.

post.summary: Create or replay the installation lifecycle qualification
post.description: Requires explicit server qualification configuration and the infrastructure identity. Unknown outcomes halt the run; repeating advance never resubmits a claimed phase. This endpoint does not enable general workload provisioning.

201.description: Run, resource records and allocation intents created atomically

manifest.description: Signed image manifest, validated against the server signer policy
